label: Merge dev into main and push
command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; git switch main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git pull origin main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git merge --no-ff dev; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git push origin main"
